python -c "
from unittest.mock import ANY
from pydantic import BaseModel

class MyModel(BaseModel):
    foo: str

print('Testing: MyModel(foo=\"bar\") == ANY')
result = MyModel(foo='bar') == ANY
print(f'Result: {result}')
print(f'Expected: True')
assert result == True, 'FAILED: BaseModel should equal ANY'
print('SUCCESS!')

# Also test that equality with other BaseModel instances still works
print()
print('Testing: BaseModel equality still works')
m1 = MyModel(foo='bar')
m2 = MyModel(foo='bar')
m3 = MyModel(foo='baz')
print(f'Model(foo=\"bar\") == Model(foo=\"bar\"): {m1 == m2}')
print(f'Model(foo=\"bar\") == Model(foo=\"baz\"): {m1 == m3}')
assert m1 == m2, 'Equal models should be equal'
assert m1 != m3, 'Different models should not be equal'
print('SUCCESS!')

# Test that equality with non-BaseModel still returns False (when the other side also doesn't match)
print()
print('Testing: BaseModel == other non-BaseModel types')
print(f'Model(foo=\"bar\") == \"bar\": {MyModel(foo=\"bar\") == \"bar\"}')
print(f'Model(foo=\"bar\") == 123: {MyModel(foo=\"bar\") == 123}')
print(f'Model(foo=\"bar\") == None: {MyModel(foo=\"bar\") == None}')
assert MyModel(foo='bar') == 'bar' == False
assert MyModel(foo='bar') == 123 == False
assert MyModel(foo='bar') == None == False
print('SUCCESS!')
"
